visual_events.label: Camera tracks right to reveal top cavities of brick-on-edge wall
visual_events.description: Low-angle close-up starting over the near corner of a partially built red-brick wall where bricks are placed on edge, leaving a row of rectangular vertical cavities between parallel stretcher and header bricks, with wet grey mortar spread across the top bedding surfaces. From 0.0s to about 3.5s, the camera moves laterally to the right so the framing aligns directly down the length of the left wall section, looking straight into a continuous line of five open cavities extending toward a dry-stacked corner pile of bricks at the far end. From 3.5s to 4.8s, the camera holds nearly steady looking down the aligned row of cavities. In the background on sandy soil sit a metal mortar pan on the left, wooden/metal straightedges on the right, a mound of grey sand/aggregate, trees, and a pink building with a red playground slide.
visual_events.context_result: Clearly reveals the internal hollow cavity geometry and brick-on-edge bond pattern along the top course of the masonry wall, with fresh grey mortar resting on top of the bricks rather than filling the cavities.
